title_sq: AMBIENT KOMERCIAL PER SHITJE TEK LSI
description_sq:
Ambienti ndodhet ne katin 0 dhe 1 te nje godine relativisht te re, buze rruges Sami Frasheri, prane ish LSI.
Ka hyrje dhe shkalle te dedikuar ne rruge kryesore dhe fasade xhami ne gjithe gjjatesine e prones ne katin 1.
Mundesi shume e mire per nje shumllojshmeri biznesesh dhe gjithashtu per qiradhenie.
Ndodhet ne zone shume te lakmuar per biznes dhe ka mundesi shume te mire rekalmimi.
Aktualisht eshte i ndare ne:
Kati 0: Holl hyres (recepsion), Aksesi i shkalleve dhe nje hapsire magazinimi
Kati 1: Nje hapsire prej 258m2 qe akstualisht eshte e ndare ne gjashte ambiente pune, nje koridor shperndares dhe dy tualete, por mund te kthehet ne open space.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion, apo nje vizite ne prone, mos nguroni te kontaktoni!
title_en: COMMERCIAL ENVIRONMENT FOR SALE AT LSI
description_en: The premises are located on the 0th and 1st floors of a relatively new building, on the edge of Sami Frasheri Street, near the former LSI. There is a dedicated entrance and stairs on the main street and a glass facade throughout the length of the property on the 1st floor. Very good opportunity for a variety of businesses and also for rent. It is located in a very coveted area for business and has very good reclamation possibilities. It is currently divided into: Floor 0: Entrance hall (reception), Stair access and a storage space Floor 1: A space of 258m2 which is currently divided into six work rooms, a distribution corridor and two toilets, but can be turned into an open space. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
